title: For any ringed site with independent universes and the sheafification hypotheses, the ordinary complex Hom(E,O[0]) of a bounded complex E with finite-free retract terms is bounded with finite-free retract terms
statement: For any ringed site with independent universes and the sheafification hypotheses, the ordinary complex Hom(E,O[0]) of a bounded complex E with finite-free retract terms is bounded with finite-free retract terms. Bounds [a,b] become [-b,-a], and the new rank in degree n is the original rank in degree -n.

proof.text: The degree-n Hom product has only the factor indexed by -n. Construct its inverse projection by the product universal property; every other factor vanishes since the target unit complex is concentrated in degree zero.

Construct Hom(O,N) to N by evaluation at 1, with inverse sending a section n to r mapped to r n. Check naturality sectionwise. Contravariant additivity and the finite biproduct isomorphism then identify the dual of a finite product of O with that product.

Apply the contravariant Hom functor to the chosen finite-product retractions of the terms of E and conjugate by the two constructed isomorphisms. Functoriality proves the splitting equation. The degree is zero outside [-b,-a] because the original source term is zero. Empty bounds and rank zero satisfy the same product argument.

theorem ringedSitePerfect_ordinaryDual
    (E : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E.X n))
    (pkg : SheafOfModules.StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite.{c, v, max c v r} _ E) :
    let D := homComplex.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R := R) E (ringedSiteDualityUnitComplex.{c,
        v, r} J R)
    (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (D.X n)) ∧
      Nonempty (SheafOfModules.StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite.{c, v, max c v r} _ D)
